item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (68)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 68

  • Choose Fast or Thorough. Thorough checks shake and blown highlights, for an overnight run.
  • An automatic rating is added only when the subject is an animal and the sharpness checks agree.
  • Scan settings holds the accept cutoff, the processor, and memory.
  • Reject and Trash use the cross-check list.
